Confidence intervals for
differences of standardized regression slopes
are generated using
the `DiffBetaMC()` function from the `betaMC` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaMC: Example Using the BetaMC Function](example-beta-mc.html).


``` r
library(package = betaMC)
```




``` r
df <- betaMC::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- stats::lm(formula = QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Monte Carlo Sampling Distribution of Parameters

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
mvn <- MC(object = object, type = "mvn")
```

#### Asymptotic distribution-free Approach


``` r
adf <- MC(object = object, type = "adf")
```

#### Heteroskedasticity Consistent Approach (HC3)


``` r
hc3 <- MC(object = object, type = "hc3")
```

### Differences of Standardized Regression Slopes

#### Normal-Theory Approach


``` r
mvn <- DiffBetaMC(object = mvn)
```

#### Asymptotic distribution-free Approach


``` r
adf <- DiffBetaMC(object = adf)
```

#### Heteroskedasticity Consistent Approach (HC3)


``` r
hc3 <- DiffBetaMC(object = hc3)
```

## Methods

### summary

Summary of the results of `DiffBetaMC()`.


``` r
summary(object = mvn)
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaMC(object = mvn)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "mvn"
#>                   est     se     R   0.05%    0.5%    2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1351 20000 -0.3368 -0.2458 -0.1660 0.3599 0.4408 0.5212
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1256 20000 -0.2108 -0.1123 -0.0244 0.4658 0.5339 0.6137
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1232 20000 -0.2861 -0.1958 -0.1181 0.3670 0.4460 0.5409
summary(object = adf)
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaMC(object = adf)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "adf"
#>                   est     se     R   0.05%    0.5%    2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1214 20000 -0.3019 -0.2029 -0.1354 0.3362 0.4209 0.4922
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1187 20000 -0.1507 -0.0786 -0.0044 0.4589 0.5342 0.6095
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1203 20000 -0.2767 -0.1899 -0.1112 0.3568 0.4293 0.5259
summary(object = hc3)
#> Call:
#> DiffBetaMC(object = hc3)
#> 
#> Differences of standardized regression slopes
#> type = "hc3"
#>                   est     se     R   0.05%    0.5%    2.5%  97.5%  99.5% 99.95%
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  0.1037 0.1425 20000 -0.3684 -0.2564 -0.1796 0.3794 0.4763 0.5672
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP 0.2319 0.1325 20000 -0.2452 -0.1259 -0.0384 0.4793 0.5539 0.6471
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 0.1282 0.1373 20000 -0.3529 -0.2364 -0.1518 0.3869 0.4706 0.5737
```

### coef

Return the vector of estimates.


``` r
stats::coef(object = mvn)
#>  NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 
#>      0.1036564      0.2318974      0.1282410
stats::coef(object = adf)
#>  NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 
#>      0.1036564      0.2318974      0.1282410
stats::coef(object = hc3)
#>  NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP 
#>      0.1036564      0.2318974      0.1282410
```

### vcov

Return the sampling covariance matrix.


``` r
stats::vcov(object = mvn)
#>                NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT    0.018249644    0.009426601   -0.008823043
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP   0.009426601    0.015783701    0.006357100
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP  -0.008823043    0.006357100    0.015180143
stats::vcov(object = adf)
#>                NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT    0.014734517    0.007174868   -0.007559649
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP   0.007174868    0.014086683    0.006911815
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP  -0.007559649    0.006911815    0.014471464
stats::vcov(object = hc3)
#>                NARTIC-PCTGRT NARTIC-PCTSUPP PCTGRT-PCTSUPP
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT     0.02030680    0.009507770   -0.010799027
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP    0.00950777    0.017556262    0.008048492
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP   -0.01079903    0.008048492    0.018847519
```

### confint

Return confidence intervals.


``` r
stats::confint(object = mvn, level = 0.95)
#>                      2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.16597827 0.3599059
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.02442948 0.4657819
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.11814942 0.3669940
stats::confint(object = adf, level = 0.95)
#>                       2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.135427123 0.3361984
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.004370207 0.4589016
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.111175117 0.3568019
stats::confint(object = hc3, level = 0.95)
#>                      2.5 %    97.5 %
#> NARTIC-PCTGRT  -0.17964282 0.3793686
#> NARTIC-PCTSUPP -0.03836701 0.4792582
#> PCTGRT-PCTSUPP -0.15183553 0.3868603
```
